metadata.title: Monochrome Portrait with Geometric Color Accents

retrievalProfile.description: A centered black-and-white portrait framed by a thick black border with wide-tracked sans-serif headers and small, vibrant geometric color blocks.
triggerTerms: framed black and white photography layout
excludeWhen: handwritten or script typography is preferred

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white portrait of a subject with soft lighting, encased in a heavy black square frame. The layout features extremely wide-tracked sans-serif text at the top and a small, rectangular blue color block containing serif text positioned asymmetrically on the right.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the organic textures of the monochrome portrait and the sharp geometric frame
Hierarchy established by the wide-tracked header versus the small, dense subtitle block
Visual tension created by the asymmetrical placement of the blue rectangular tag
Balance between the dark shadows of the subject and the solid black outer border
coreInvariants: Heavy black outer border framing the central image
Wide letter-spacing in the primary display text
High-contrast black and white photography style

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered, occupying approximately 70% of the frame, shown from the chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright blue accent block on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the wide-tracked top text, move down to the subject's face, and settle on the blue accent block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial negative space provided by the thick black border and the dark background behind the subject.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blue (accent block and specific letters)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the portrait; high saturation in the small geometric accents.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to two distinct shades of blue for accents

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif and classic transitional serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary header uses uniform stroke weight sans-serif
Secondary text uses high-contrast serif with bracketed terminals
Extreme tracking (letter-spacing) applied to the header
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial letters of words in the header are color-coded to match the accent blocks
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a wide-tracked modern sans-serif with a traditional, tightly-set serif.

avoid: Distorting the aspect ratio of the frame

candidateDirections.reason: Clean geometric skeletons suitable for wide tracking in the header.
Classic serif feel for the small accent block text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white studio portrait of a person with soft hair texture, centered within a thick solid black square frame. Include a small cyan square in the bottom left corner and a medium blue rectangle on the right edge overlapping the image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in a wide-tracked white sans-serif at the top, making the first letter of each word blue. Add the title in a small white serif font inside the blue rectangle on the right.

verificationChecks: Is the header tracking extremely wide?
Are the first letters of the header words blue?
Does the blue rectangle overlap the image edge?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent monolinear stroke in the header font
Ensure the blue rectangle has a sharp, clean edge
Verify the image-to-border ratio remains approximately 4:1
Confirm the cyan block is present in the bottom left
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Portrait + Thick Black Frame + Wide-Tracked Sans Header + Asymmetrical Color Block Subtitle
